collate_atomic_data_list_to_batch: collate a list of AtomicData objects into a single batch using data_list_collater
collate_atomic_data_with_neighbors: collate AtomicData objects and compute neighbor counts from edge_index for each data point
collate_atomic_data_to_dict: collate a list of AtomicData objects and return the batch as a dictionary of tensors

review_data_list_collater: review the data_list_collater function to understand how AtomicData batches are constructed and neighbor counts computed
